content: Abstrakt (DE: das Abstract, ENG: abstract, IT: abstract) Krátke zhrnutie obsahu vedeckej práce alebo diela.
Aforizmus (DE: der Aphorismus, ENG: aphorism, IT: aforisma) Krátke a výstižné múdre vyjadrenie alebo myšlienka.
Akrofóbia (DE: die Akrophobie, ENG: acrophobia, IT: acrofobia) Strach z výšok.
Alea (DE: das Alea, ENG: chance, IT: alea) Náhoda alebo nepredvídatelný faktor.
Alegorický (DE: allegorisch, ENG: allegorical, IT: allegorico) Vyjadrený symbolickým obrazom alebo príbehom.
Alegória (DE: die Allegorie, ENG: allegory, IT: allegoria) Symbolické znázornenie abstraktnej myšlienky.
Postulate - Principle or assumption considered self-evident.
Pragmatic - Guided by practicality, not theory.
Pragmatism - Philosophical approach evaluating ideas by their practical consequences.
Pragmatics - Study of language use in the context of communication.
Precedent - Previous case or decision serving as a model for future situations.
Preconception - Preconceived opinion or idea before experience.
Premise - Starting statement from which a conclusion is derived.
Procrastination - Delaying duties until later.
Prolegomena - Introductory remarks or notes for the study of a book or science.
Propaedeutics - Introductory and preparatory study of a certain discipline.
Personification - Literary figure where inanimate objects or abstract concepts gain human qualities.
Contradictory - Having opposite or conflicting qualities.
Prototype - Original model from which others are created.
Pseudonym - Fake or artificial name of an author.
